records.source: A gift that shows your romantic interest.
records.translation: Regalong nagpapakita ng iyong romantikong pagkagusto.

records.englishResidueReason: Baguette is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this specific bread shape.

records.preserveReason: Bream is the conventional common species name used to distinguish this specific game fish.

records.source: A fairly common river fish that becomes active at night.
records.translation: Medyo karaniwang isda sa ilog na nagiging aktibo sa gabi.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o palamutian ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: The flowering head of a broccoli plant. The tiny buds give it a unique texture.
records.translation: Ulo ng bulaklak ng halamang brokoli. Nagbibigay ng natatanging tekstura ang mumunting usbong.

records.source: Plant in the fall. Takes 8 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
records.translation: Itanim sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 8 araw upang mahinog at patuloy na namumunga matapos ang unang ani.

records.englishResidueReason: CD is the standard technical abbreviation printed on the physical disc and used in Filipino.

records.source: It's a JojaNet 2.0 trial CD. They must've made a billion of these things.
records.translation: Pansubok na CD ito ng JojaNet 2.0. Tiyak na gumawa sila ng isang bilyong ganito.
records.englishResidueReason: JojaNet 2.0 is a fictional product name, and CD is the standard technical abbreviation for the physical medium.

records.source: It looks like someone lost their glasses. They're busted.
records.translation: Mukhang may nawalan ng salamin sa mata. Sira na ito.

records.preserveReason: Bruschetta is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this specific Italian dish.

records.source: Roasted tomatoes on a crisp white bread.
records.translation: Inihaw na kamatis sa malutong na puting tinapay.

records.source: It's a juicy wad of bug flesh.
records.translation: Makatas na kumpol ito ng laman ng insekto.

records.source: The last resort of the hungry cave diver.
records.translation: Huling mapagpipilian ng gutom na manggagalugad ng yungib.

records.preserveReason: Bullhead is the conventional common species name used to distinguish this specific game fish.

records.source: A relative of the catfish that eats a variety of foods off the lake bottom.
records.translation: Kamag-anak ng hito na kumakain ng iba't ibang pagkain mula sa ilalim ng lawa.

records.source: Monsters have a greater chance of dropping loot.
records.translation: Mas mataas ang tsansang maglaglag ng samsam ang mga halimaw.

records.source: Sprinkle on a pet to remove them from your farm. The process is irreversible.
records.translation: Ibudbod sa alagang hayop upang alisin ito sa iyong Bukid. Hindi na ito maibabalik.

records.source: The sweet fruit of the prickly pear cactus.
records.translation: Matamis na bunga ng kaktus na peras-tinik.

records.source: Can only be grown indoors. Takes 12 days to mature, and then produces fruit every 3 days.
records.translation: Sa loob lamang maaaring palaguin. Tumatagal ng 12 araw upang mahinog, pagkatapos ay namumunga kada 3 araw.

records.source: This yellow crystal is speckled with shimmering nodules.
records.translation: Ang dilaw na kristal na ito ay may mga kumikinang na tuldok.

records.source: A unique egg that can be found during the Desert Festival.
records.translation: Natatanging itlog na matatagpuan sa Pista sa Disyerto.

records.source: Break apart to obtain Calico Eggs.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng mga Itlog ng Calico.
